segments.oily: One reviewer with acne-prone/oily-leaning skin says the cleanser purges sebum and clears blackheads and whiteheads after a few minutes of massage.
segments.combination: A combination-skin reviewer reports it purged stubborn blackheads and large pores and left skin clearer and softer within three days.
segments.sensitive: Multiple self-identified sensitive-skin reviewers report no stinging, burning, or irritation, describing it as gentle, lightweight, and fragrance-free enough for daily use.
segments.mature: No reviews specifically describe mature skin.

concerns.aging: Not discussed by reviewers in relation to this cleanser; one mentions a separate Bubble eye cream for puffiness, not this product.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers report the oil leaves skin hydrated, soft, and not stripped; one dissenting reviewer found it too thick and rough, comparing it to 'used motor oil.'
concerns.redness: One reviewer states it deep-cleans without leaving redness; no other reviewer discusses redness specifically.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers describe it as gentle and non-stripping even with daily double-cleansing; no reports of barrier damage.
concerns.spots: Two reviewers with clogged pores/blackheads report visible purging and clearer skin within days of use.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer reports a visible difference in her acne after use; another says it clears skin and leaves it soft, but no volume of acne-specific reports beyond these two.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer notes no oily residue afterward despite being an oil cleanser; no other comments on oil control.

extraits.titre: The worst cleansing oil I've ever tried
extraits.texte: This is probably a great oil cleanser if you're 14 and only wear concealer. This is a terrible oil cleanser if you're an adult and you wear a full face of makeup. I have to use about 10 pumps just to get enough of the product out, and it doesn't remove waterproof mascara. I know Bubble is meant for preteens and teens, but the price point was hard to pass up.

this cleanser is so thick and even a little hard to pump out. it has zero slip! i tried removing a full face of makeup and it was really rough on my skin and especially terrible on my waterproof makeup. i think it even damaged my lashes a little. i need an oil cleanser that easily melts everything right off. that being said, i did use it on a bare face just for cleansing and it did make my skin really soft. ill finish the bottle using it that way but i wont purchase again

got my first bottle a while back and I loved it cause the consistency was thin so it was fast and easy to remove my makeup but I recently repurchased it and the consistency is much thicker now, I feel like I'm slathering used motor oil on my face :( I will still keep this bottle cause I need it and it gets the job done but would love to have the old formula

I was pleasantly surprised by this product! As someone with combination skin, I've struggled with stubborn blackheads and large pores for a long time. I've tried numerous solutions to get rid of them, but nothing worked—until now! After applying this product to my face and rubbing it in for a few minutes, I could see my blackheads and sebaceous pores starting to purge. I left it on my skin for about 10 to 15 minutes, continuing to massage it in. After just three days of using this product, my skin has never looked clearer or felt so soft.

I have tried a lot of oil cleansers to remove makeup and double cleanse my skin. This one is so amazing especially considering the price!!! It is so easy to emulsify and gently breaks down makeup and unclogs your pores, leaving your skin feeling extremely hydrated and not stripped!! It also does not burn your eyes or get super cloudy as most oil cleansers do when they get in your eyes!! I was so pleasantly surprised with this product!

I like first class so that I can dibble cleans because I also have the fresh start. I love first class because you can LITERALLY massage your black heads and white heads out so all that sebum in your nose, GONE! Just massage first class on your face for about 2-5 mins and depending on your skin type the sebum will come out in2-5 mknutes!

I am in love with the first class oil cleanser! It left my skin feeling so soft and smooth. I would highly recommend this product to anyone with sensitive skin - like mine! It didn't irritate my skin at all and I loved the results! The absolute best!!
